formulas.d: |log2((a + 0.5) / (b + 0.5))| per 1 kb bin; bins with a + b == 0 dropped
formulas.blacklist: with --blacklist: a 1 kb bin is dropped if any of its 40 x 25 bp sub-bins overlaps the BED by >= 1 bp (knob_effects.bad_bins); none dropped without it
formulas.d_hat: mean of d in 40 quantile bins of level (unique edges), assigned per bin as a step function (binned conditional mean)
formulas.R2_level: 1 - var(d - d_hat) / var(d), all kept bins
formulas.R2_level_ols: OLS R^2 of d on [1, d_hat] on the subsample rows with finite features
formulas.R2_level_feat: OLS R^2 of d on [1, d_hat, features, ctx==1, ctx==2] on the same rows
formulas.delta_R2: R2_level_feat - R2_level_ols (both OLS on the same rows)
formulas.delta_R2_shuffle: the same with feature + ctx rows permuted jointly (seed 0)
formulas.deciles: rank deciles over kept bins, ties averaged, NaN excluded
formulas.enrichment: share of the top-1 % r bins in the class / the class's share of kept bins
